title: "Data" object from older version of PyG
author: carles-marti

comments.author: carles-marti
comments.body:
I figured out some (maybe all?) data can be retrieved using `.__dict__`. Assuming the following snippet is executed using a newer (v>2.0) version of torch-geometric, would the following approach be comprehensive and hence retrieve all of the data stored in old (v<=1.7.2) Data objects? 

```from torch_geometric.data.data import Data
def pyg_old2new_data(data: Data) -> Data:
   """Convert PyG data.Data objects from old (v<=1.7) to current version."""
    return Data(**data.__dict__)```
